metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did sourthern African countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need precipitation data - CHIRPS is good for rainfall in Africa - Time periods: * Target period: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 (2 months) * Baseline period: Dec+Jan for each year from 2000-2019 (20 years) - Location: Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho - need to create a polygon covering these countries 2. Masking strategy: - Rainfall data doesn't need cloud masking - Need to handle missing data in CHIRPS 3. Logic: - Calculate mean rainfall for target period (Dec 2018 + Jan 2019) - Calculate mean rainfall for baseline (Dec+Jan for 2000-2019) - Compare if target < baseline - Check for valid data in both periods Let me structure this: 1. Create geometry for southern African countries 2. Get CHIRPS data for both periods 3. Calculate mean rainfall for each period 4. Compare and determine if target < baseline 5. Handle any missing data cases ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry for southern African countries const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.inList('country_na', ['Namibia', 'Botswana', 'Lesotho'])); // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation // Target period: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 const targetPeriod = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01') .filterBounds(countries); // Baseline period: Dec+Jan for 2000-2019 (20 years) const baselinePeriod = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2000-12-01', '2020-02-01') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 1, 'month')) .filterBounds(countries); // Check collection sizes const targetSize = targetPeriod.size().getInfo(); const baselineSize = baselinePeriod.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period images: ${targetSize}`); console.log(`Baseline period images: ${baselineSize}`); if (targetSize === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean precipitation // Target period mean const targetMean = targetPeriod.sum() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: countries, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Baseline period mean (annual Dec+Jan means, then average those) const baselineAnnualMeans = ee.ImageCollection( ee.List.sequence(2000, 2019).map(function(year) { const decJan = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 11, 1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year+1, 1, 31)) .sum(); return decJan.set('year', year); }) ); const baselineMean = baselineAnnualMeans.mean() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: countries, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const targetCount = targetPeriod.sum() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: countries, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const baselineCount = baselineAnnualMeans.mean() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: countries, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Target pixels: ${targetCount}, Baseline pixels: ${baselineCount}`); if (targetCount === 0 || baselineCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Target mean: ${targetMean?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Baseline mean: ${baselineMean?.toFixed(2)} mm`); if (targetMean === null || baselineMean === null || isNaN(targetMean) || isNaN(baselineMean)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (targetMean < baselineMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
